variables.name: TO_HTML_PARAGRAPH_LINES_CONSECUTIVE
variables.comment: * Option for {@link #fromHtml(String, int)}: Wrap consecutive lines of text delimited by '\n' * inside <p> elements. {@link BulletSpan}s are ignored.

variables.name: TO_HTML_PARAGRAPH_LINES_INDIVIDUAL
variables.comment: * Option for {@link #fromHtml(String, int)}: Wrap each line of text delimited by '\n' inside a * <p> or a <li> element. This allows {@link ParagraphStyle}s attached to be * encoded as CSS styles within the corresponding <p> or <li> element.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_SEPARATOR_LINE_BREAK_PARAGRAPH
variables.comment: * Flag indicating that texts inside <p> elements will be separated from other texts with * one newline character by default.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_SEPARATOR_LINE_BREAK_HEADING
variables.comment: * Flag indicating that texts inside <h1>~<h6> elements will be separated from * other texts with one newline character by default.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_SEPARATOR_LINE_BREAK_LIST_ITEM
variables.comment: * Flag indicating that texts inside <li> elements will be separated from other texts * with one newline character by default.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_SEPARATOR_LINE_BREAK_LIST
variables.comment: * Flag indicating that texts inside <ul> elements will be separated from other texts * with one newline character by default.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_SEPARATOR_LINE_BREAK_DIV
variables.comment:
* Flag indicating that texts inside <code><div><c/ode> elements will be separated from other texts
     * with one newline character by default.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_SEPARATOR_LINE_BREAK_BLOCKQUOTE
variables.comment: * Flag indicating that texts inside <blockquote> elements will be separated from other * texts with one newline character by default.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_OPTION_USE_CSS_COLORS
variables.comment:
* Flag indicating that CSS color values should be used instead of those defined in
     * {@link Color}.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_MODE_LEGACY
variables.comment:
* Flags for {@link #fromHtml(String, int, ImageGetter, TagHandler)}: Separate block-level
     * elements with blank lines (two newline characters) in between. This is the legacy behavior
     * prior to N.

variables.name: FROM_HTML_MODE_COMPACT
variables.comment:
* Flags for {@link #fromHtml(String, int, ImageGetter, TagHandler)}: Separate block-level
     * elements with line breaks (single newline character) in between. This inverts the
     * {@link Spanned} to HTML string conversion done with the option
     * {@link #TO_HTML_PARAGRAPH_LINES_INDIVIDUAL}.

methods.comment:

     * ignored and {@link Html#fromHtml(String)} is used.
